rubric.note: Gates are all green. Points are lost for B1 (a regression of an invariant the control already pins for the log) and for the survivors listed under non_blocking_findings.

blocking_findings.defect: rm -rf "$dir" "$dir.profile" runs unconditionally, also for --golden-only. A golden-only run keeps its own log name ($dir.golden.log) precisely so it does not destroy the rig/full log of the same commit, but the profile dir is named <sha>.profile for both, so rig/golden deletes the rig/full run's <sha>.profile/.
blocking_findings.failing_scenario: tools/rig_nightly.sh runs 'rig_check.sh <sha>' (rig/full, profiled, writes <sha>.profile/) and later 'rig_check.sh <sha> --golden-only' on the same main head once the GPU is idle. The second run removes <sha>.profile/ before it starts, so every nightly's raw profile rows are gone as soon as the golden half begins; the rig silently stops keeping what the change exists to measure. Reproduced hermetically: I adapted tools/test_rig_keep_going.sh (git stub copies the instrument, real make 3.81 and gmake 4.4.1) and listed the profile dir around its golden-log-kept step. Before: closure.txt database.txt header.txt load.tsv profile.tsv ... ; after the --golden-only run: 'No such file or directory', on both makes. The existing golden-log-kept case asserts the full log survives, and no case asserts the same for the profile.
blocking_findings.proposed_fix: Only remove a stale profile dir for runs that write one: change line 75 to rm -rf "$dir"; [ $tests = 1 ] && rm -rf "$dir.profile" (keep the set -e safe form: if [ $tests = 1 ]; then rm -rf "$dir.profile"; fi). Add a control case (or extend golden-log-kept in test_rig_keep_going.sh with the tools copied in) that runs full then --golden-only on one RIG_DIR and asserts <dir>.profile/profile.tsv survives.

non_blocking_findings.defect: RIG_TRACE=1 is not pinned anywhere: the control unsets RIG_TRACE at the top, the nested caller-poison run only sets it to prove it is ignored, and no case sets it deliberately. Mutant m02 (trace=--trace -> trace=) survives. Design 1d lists RIG_TRACE=1 as a behaviour, and AC3's traced baseline run depends on it.
non_blocking_findings.fix: Add a profile-on-trace case: RIG_TRACE=1 exported inside the case's subshell; the gmake stub transcript must contain '--trace -k test'.

non_blocking_findings.defect: The summary closing the log is only pinned as 'a ^totals line exists' on a one-row fixture. Mutants m03 (NR <= 11 -> NR <= 3), m19 (drop the /^totals/ alternative), m09 (silent profile-summary-failed line), m29 (suppress the summary when make test is red) and m05 (no summary on the gmake-missing path) all survive. 'Top 10 at the end of the log, pass or fail' is therefore unverified by the control.
non_blocking_findings.fix: Use a fixture profile.tsv with 15+ distinct targets and assert header + exactly 10 rows + totals; add a red profile-on case asserting the summary is present; add a corrupt-profile case for the one-line failure.

non_blocking_findings.defect: The gmake-missing branch's bounded wrapper is unpinned: m13 (drop bounded from that branch) survives, because no hang case runs under the no-gmake PATH. The row-7ag promise 'every make call is bounded' can silently lapse on that branch. m06 (profile-absent test shrinks to suite_profile.sh only) also survives: no case has one of the two files without the other.
non_blocking_findings.fix: A test-hang variant under NOGMAKE (RIG_TEST_S=2, STUB_MAKE_HANG=test) and a case with only tools/suite_profile.sh present.

non_blocking_findings.defect: The keep-going control's fake clone has no tools/, so it only ever runs the profile-absent plain-make path; the profiled path's failing-target parser on real gmake output is not covered by any committed case. (The executor says so in M3.) I checked it by hand with a modified copy: two-red, golden, green, nightly cases all pass profiled on make 3.81 and gmake 4.4.1, so behaviour is right, just not pinned. Also m01 (dropping the stale-$dir.profile cleanup) survives.
non_blocking_findings.fix: Give keep-going a profiled variant (copy the instrument into the fixture clone) and a stale-profile-dir case.

non_blocking_findings.defect: Plan wording 'real /opt/homebrew/bin/gmake unreachable from every case' is true only for the rig_check.sh invocations in prun/order. keep-going and suite-profile deliberately run real GNU make and gmake on fixtures (pre-existing, intended). <sha>.profile/ is never pruned (it holds database.txt, a make -p dump), unlike the clones deleted on exit.
non_blocking_findings.fix: Document; consider pruning <sha>.profile/ older than N days in rig_nightly.sh.
